I'll loop in Finance & CS to confirm credit mechanics and any constraints on price holds. If you prefer, I can present this to your procurement team next week.

Team — reading through this, my recommendation to keep gross margin protected while making a commercial concession:

1) Offer a 90-day firm price stabilizer at current list effective rates (hard hold).
2) Followed by a 3-month conditional hold (months 91–180) where the price remains unchanged provided usage tracks to the agreed committed bands in the MAP. If usage is >120% of forecast in that window, we reserve the right to reprice to the next tier — this is purely to protect capacity economics.
3) Onboarding credit: $25k one-time invoice credit, released after completion of a shared milestone checklist (infra validation + success criteria), recorded in the MAP.
4) Require PO + signed SOW before the start of the renewal term; onboarding credit applied on first invoice after go-live.

Rationale: 90-day hard hold is narrow enough to limit exposure; conditional months give the customer runway to ramp while preserving our ability to correct misforecast risk. If leadership wants to be more customer-friendly, we can extend to 180-day hard hold but only with a commitment to an accelerated volume band or higher upfront payment.

Marissa/Monica — if the milestone checklist is crisp (3 items max) I can get approvals for the credit. Vivek — FYI for leadership discretion.

—Ben
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference

Alyssa / Procurement —

Thanks for the fast turnaround. Based on internal review, here is our proposed written offer:

- Term: 12 months (effective on signed SOW start date).
- Capacity: committed uplift of 40% as outlined in MAP_v1.xlsx.
- Price stabilizer: 90-day hard hold at current unit rates starting on term effective date, then a 90-day conditional hold (months 91–180) that remains at the same rate provided usage stays within committed bands. If usage exceeds 120% of forecast in the conditional window, Redwood may reprice to the next tier (we'll provide 10 business days notice).
- Onboarding credit: $25,000 invoice credit applied after completion of the joint milestone checklist (infra validated, production cutover, first 1M tokens processed). Checklist is in MAP_v1.xlsx.
- Security: SOC2 summary attached; log retention confirmed at 90 days by default (we can extend via our Private product if needed).
- Contract mechanics: PO + signed SOW required prior to go-live; we will issue credit on first invoice post go-live.

I've uploaded the updated renewal draft and the MAP with milestone checkboxes. If this looks acceptable, please confirm and I'll send the DocuSign packet (renewal + SOW). DocuSign link (placeholder): https://docsend.com/d/nb-redwood-renewal-ds

If procurement wants a slightly longer hard hold, we can consider 6 months but would ask for either a higher committed band or a 50% upfront payment on the first invoice.

Proposed next steps:
- Procurement confirm if PO routing/timing works (procurement@northbound.ai).
- Alyssa confirm acceptance or request edits by EOD Thursday; if accepted, we push DocuSign and target signature next week.
